test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
C, D, G, H, I, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit between D and C when counted from the left of C. K sits third to the left of I. H sits to the immediate right of I. H sits second to the left of D. L is not an immediate neighbour of K

Who sits third to the right of G?
solution: **Given:** C, D, G, H, I, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between D and C when counted from the left of C. H sits second to the left of D.
